messages:
jess: FYI incidentbot didn't page at 03:12. We got a suppressed alert and no on-call page. :rotating_light:
incidentbot: [automated] Alert received: /notify -> 502 from pagerflow (suppressed by suppressor v2 rule)
raj: omg, saw a spike in 502s around 03:10. Any manual pages yet?
ben: Not automatically. I just checked the notify-bridge logs:
ben: ```level=error ts=2026-03-18T03:12:08Z component=notifybridge msg="webhook to pagerflow failed" status=502 id=ab12ef```
ben: incidentbot shows the alert routed but suppressor flagged it: `suppressor.rule_id=opt-out-github-webhooks`
micah: I just called the on-call (sre-oncall) and left a voicemail. Manual page sent via the emergency channel.
sre-oncall: joining call now. I'm seeing the 502 fanout in the tracing. Looks like a recent suppressor regex is matching the header `X-Source: internal-ci` which we started adding last week.
jess: That matches my suspicion — we deployed a suppressor tweak in the last config PR. Rolling it back now is safest.
raj: Can someone post the deploy command? I'll stand by to revert quickly.
ben: Revert command: ```./deployctl rollback --service=suppressor --to=origin/main~1 --reason="unintended suppression of pagerflow alerts"```
micah: Doing manual revert in staging first. If green, I'll push to prod. ETA 8 mins.
incidentbot: [automated] Suppression-config updated by micah (rollback start).
ben: Confirmed staging: alerts are no longer suppressed. Pushing to prod in 30s.
jess: Manual pages cleared after prod rollback — customers on the dashboard show recovery. We had ~17 customer-facing failed deliveries during the 6 minute window.
sre-oncall: Received manual page and joined mitigation. We called out impacted customers in the incident channel and put a low-severity banner on status.redwood.com.
raj: Any secondary effects? caches, queues?
ben: No queue backlog; notify-bridge retried and processed the backlog once suppression lifted. No lost messages identified so far.
jess: Immediate mitigation: rollback suppressor, manual paging to on-call for the window, status page update, notify support to proactively outreach to affected customers.
micah: Follow-ups: 1) Add unit test for the suppressor regex and header edge-cases. 2) Add a deploy-time smoke check that sends a synthetic alert which must page on-call. 3) Postmortem owner: raj.
raj: I'll own the postmortem. I'll include timeline, root cause (suppresser regex + deploy review gap), impact (17 deliveries failed, 6 min outage of paging), and action items.
incidentbot: [automated] Incident labeled: pagerflow-suppressor-false-positive, severity: sev2.
ben: Filing a ticket in ops-infra with logs attached.
jess: Thanks everyone. Good quick ops work. micah, can you open a PR for the smoke-test before EOD?
micah: Yep, will do. PR link when created. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: Closing the live call. I'll stay on-call for 15 more minutes to monitor.
jess: last note — please add the exact suppressor rule snapshot to the postmortem so we can avoid similar regressions.
raj: Will include the config diff and the deploy window. Closing thread when postmortem is filed.
